KEN.note: Nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
The AI claims system sits in the health insurance sector, not general administration.

facts.fact: Health CS Aden Duale told senators that fraud detection at the Social Health Authority is enabled by an artificial intelligence-driven claims management system that blocks suspicious billing before payment.

Duale said the digital gatekeeper had flagged, rejected and left unpaid Sh12.7 billion of claims by late February 2026, with 1,188 fraudulent files sent to the DCI, 26 suspects charged and 248 facilities under probe.

KEN.note: No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in the country is stated.
Health data hosted locally under a Kenya-US partnership is stated, with no rule requiring it.
